identity.evidence: The published logo file is byte-identical (SHA-256 verified 2026-11-27) to the UiPath mark file distributed by Simple Icons at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/develop/icons/uipath.svg — the documented source of this published file (web/assets/logos/README.md lists 'uipath' among the Simple Icons files used for startup logos). UiPath's official website (https://www.uipath.com/) publishes the same mark as its JSON-LD logo (https://images.ctfassets.net/5965pury2lcm/3q6Ynw5gw9R1ImKytcmsaT/e421c11ac8e7297c838c68fd5ecdadff/uipath-logo-digital-rgb-b.png), confirming the glyph is UiPath's own brand mark.

rights.evidence: The published file is distributed by Simple Icons under CC0 1.0 (local copy: web/assets/logos/simple-icons-CC0.txt). The underlying brand mark remains the organisation's property and is shown with source and attribution for identification only.
